changes: Rewrote `/agent/solver.md` to make the verification steps mandatory before submitting. The agent must run every public example, stress-test a brute-force reference on small random inputs (and not submit on any mismatch), time maximum-size inputs, and check Python complexity limits up front. The failure reports showed submits without any public-example run (lcb-3655) and submits despite a brute-force mismatch (lcb-arc193-d). `validate()` passes. One trial on lcb-3655 now runs the public examples before submitting, but it still fails the hidden tests on a wrong-answer case (got 80458, expected 93646), so the prompt change did not fix that problem. I did not add a skill or sub-agent.
final:
